Title: JYHAD: question on Anson with Short Term investment

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
The Undertaker <death@cats.ucsc.edu> wrote:
>If a player has out both Anson and a Short Term Investment, which
>of the following can happen during the master phase:
>	The player can take two blood counters from STI 
>	The player can take one blood counter from STI and play a master card

Yes to both of these.  Anson essentially allows a full second action during
your master phase.  Remember that if you use an out-of-turn master card
you're burning your next master *phase*, not your next master *action*,
so Anson won't allow you to still use a master action during your next
turn, or to use two out-of-turn masters between turns.
